turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm finally deep into the MOTIF Hand integration. It's a beast.
Sounds complex. What's the biggest hurdle right now?

The sensor fusion pipeline. I've got it set up with the dense tactile arrays (6×6, 2.5mm resolution, 20g trigger) and the 9-axis IMUs at each joint. Plus, there's an onboard FLIR Lepton 3.5 thermal camera, a ToF depth sensor, and an RGB camera. It's a lot of data streams to sync.
That is a heavy load. Have you managed to get the timestamps aligned?
Mostly. I'm struggling with the thermal camera latency though. It's lagging behind the tactile data.
Thermal sensors often have higher latency due to frame rates. Maybe try buffering the tactile data to match?
I'll try that. Also, do you know if the local hardware store has any USB-C cables in stock? Mine just frayed.
I can't check real-time inventory, but Best Buy or Micro Center usually have plenty. Want me to check their online availability?
No worries, I'll swing by later. Thanks for the sync tip.
